classification: Complete development smoke with diagnosed asymmetric date-scope evidence mapping

issues.detail: Custom month-grouped query results were stamped with the whole query date range, discarding actual row-month scope. Seven analytics routes returned all four required values but lost provenance credit for valid subperiod claims.

Wren result evidence omitted date qualifiers, and the scorer treated missing source scope as a wildcard. The equivalent financial evidence was therefore not checked symmetrically across backends. Final correction must derive supported scopes from validated plans/AST and reject unknown scope rather than remove date checks.

interpretation: All 54 planned development episodes completed with unchanged source and full scoped ledger/document/vector fingerprint. There were no transport errors. The evidence mapping defect makes this run diagnostic and ineligible for architecture selection. Original raw records, scores and usage are preserved. Derived-citation validation failures, entity protocol mismatches and unavailable baseline capabilities remain legitimate recorded failures, not reasons to weaken checks. No held-out outcome informed corrections.
